مِسْفَرٌ : see مِسْفَرَةٌ. ―
-b2- Also A man (TA) that journeys, or travels, much; (K;) and so ↓ مِسْفَارٌ : (A:) or that journeys, or travels, much, and is strong for journeying: (M:) and, applied to a camel, (S, M, A,) strong for journeying; (S, M, A, K;) fem. with ة, (S, M, K,) applied to a she-camel, (S, M,) as also ↓ مِسْفَارٌ , thus applied. (M.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
